frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a well-defined isodense intraconal lesion with intrinsic high-density areas and specific MRI signal characteristics decided it.

support_spans: right eye was anophthalmic following enucleation in 2010 for a large choroidal melanoma
Orbital CT showed a well-defined isodense intraconal lesion measuring 2.6 × 2.5 × 2.4 mm
MRI demonstrated a hyperintense mass on T1-weighted images and hypointense signal on T2-weighted images
contradict_spans: General physical examination and systemic metastatic evaluation were negative
